name: TVB Limited
summary: Television Broadcasts Limited (TVBCF), founded in Kowloon, Hong Kong in 1967, is a multifaceted media enterprise primarily involved in free-to-air television broadcasting, content creation, and a diverse range of related services. The company's operations are strategically divided into several core segments. Its Hong Kong TV Broadcasting division is responsible for transmitting television programs and commercials across terrestrial platforms, producing original content, managing an online social media presence, and overseeing music entertainment, event organization, and digital marketing initiatives. The Over-The-Top (OTT) Streaming segment delivers digital streaming services and operates various web portals. Within its e-Commerce Business, TVBCF manages online retail platforms including Ztore, Neigbuy, and Big Big Shop. Beyond its domestic market, the company maintains robust international operations. The Mainland China Operations segment concentrates on co-producing television dramas and distributing its programs and channels to broadcasters and video operators throughout mainland China. Concurrently, the International Operations segment extends pay television and OTT services to global subscribers, distributing content and channels to markets such as Malaysia, Singapore, and other international regions. Furthermore, Television Broadcasts Limited engages in a broad array of supplementary activities. These encompass providing agency services for advertising design, production, and exhibition; managing film rights; offering consultancy and representation for artists; producing, publishing, and licensing musical works; and selling sound recordings. The company also ventures into motion picture production for theatrical distribution, offers satellite and subscription television programming, and handles program licensing and dealership services. Additional business interests include corporate finance services, supplying marketing materials, property investment, and online grocery sales.
